text: The Subcommittee on the Protection of Affordable Rental Housing will elect a Chair from among its members. All members are eligible to serve as Chair.

The Subcommittee on the Protection of Affordable Rental Housing: 1. Elected Councillor Paula Fletcher as Chair of the Subcommittee on the Protection of Affordable Rental Housing for a term of office starting July 16, 2019 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
